scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@aegisai/shared && npm run build --workspace=@aegisai/api && vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@aegisai/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@aegisai/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@aegisai/api && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@aegisai/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
